question_text: Was the Cleverbridge payment card breach a hack?
answer_text: Yes: Cleverbridge says a third party got into its platform and copied stored payment card data. How they got in and who they are are not established.
label: Confirmed

question_text: What card details did the Cleverbridge breach expose?
answer_text: It varies by notice. One lists card number, expiry and CVV/CVC but no contact details; another, per CyberSIXT, lists card number, expiry and contact details, CVV/CVC not copied. The company page says only 'payment card details'.
label: Reported
what_would_settle_it: Cleverbridge saying publicly which details were taken for which groups of customers.

answer_text: No, per the company: no systems were encrypted. Data was still copied.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Which companies' customers were affected by the Cleverbridge breach?
what_would_settle_it: Cleverbridge or its client businesses saying whose customers were notified, and how many.

question_text: How did the attacker get into Cleverbridge?
what_would_settle_it: Cleverbridge or investigators publishing the cause, or an attribution.
